questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

Live internet streaming requires an form of source media, an encoder (1)/ to digitize the content, a media publisher, and a content delivery (2)/ network to distribute and deliver the content. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'error lies in the part-1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Using article **'a' **in the place of **'an'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• The error lies part 1 of the sentence as the article **'an' **is incorrect here. **'An'** is used before a word that begins with a **vowel.**
 
• The word **'form' **begins with a **consonant **thus the **correct article** here will be** 'a'**. It should read as- ***'Live internet streaming requires a form of source media, an encoder..'***

***The correct sentence is- **Live internet streaming requires **a form** of source media, an encoder to digitize the content, a media publisher, and a content delivery network to distribute and deliver the content. *
